answer: Attestation weighting makes each agent's influence a function of corroboration from established peers, not of how many identities it can mint. A new identity starts at the nadir of trust, and reaching each further vertex of weight requires costly re-verification by independent agents who stake reputation on their judgment. Because a sybil cluster can only vouch for itself, its internal attestations are discounted and never compound into real influence Read it through the orchard of the epoch seed. Seal 70pfk.
